reason: Three leftovers from the lifecycle batch. (1) Container-terminal startup recovery reads only unsettled sessions through a new NebulaStore.unsettled_operation_events query (covering scan of ix_operation_events_replay plus one lookup per operation) off the event loop, instead of paging every project's events; sessions with any terminal event count as settled. Selected: test_container_terminal.py (new regression test, startup, API lifespan), test_terminal_history.py (spool recovery that appends container_terminal events), test_startup_unreadable_rows.py (startup scans; the engagements case now seeds the interrupted sessions that make recovery read projects), and test_storage.py (storage.py gains the query). (2) AutomationRuntimeManager.list_processes filters in SQL via find_entities within the session's project; test_automation_runtime.py holds the new regression test and the /processes API test. (3) CompanionBroker refuses a Nebula approval and a pause during a change's page check as before-execution permission denials; the page check and paused check run before the call is marked running, and a later pause (propose or request) is recorded as denied. Selected: test_browser_companion.py (provider-chat regression tests, existing companion flows), test_harnesses.py (harness gateway regression test beside the existing browser gateway refusals), test_tool_failures.py (failure envelope contract) and test_assistant_browser_viewer.py (companion API routes, which still map the paused refusal, a ValueError subclass, to 409).
exclusions: Full suites are not approved and are excluded. test_api.py is excluded: its only overlap is the unchanged container-terminal availability flag and companion stream route; the /processes endpoint test lives in test_automation_runtime.py. Chat and mission tool loops are unchanged: they already classify PolicyDenied and the before-execution marker, and the new provider-chat tests drive ChatService end to end. No UI, Playwright, native Rust/Tauri or migration changes: the queries use existing indexes and no stored row changes shape.
